whenToUse: Keyboard driven palettes in a modal that search actions, pages and settings from one input
Search lists of files, team members, favorites and recent pages that narrow as the user types
Inline menus kept open in a card or panel, with grouped rows and keyboard shortcut hints

whenNotToUse.when: A form field that keeps the option the user picks, such as a country or an assignee
A complete product layout with sidebar navigation, where search is only one of its parts
A top bar above your page with brand, menus and alerts, where search sits beside them

agentNotes: No example gives a `CommandItem` a select handler, so pressing Enter or clicking a row runs nothing until you add one
`CommandList` stops at 18rem tall in every style and scrolls the rows past that height inside itself
